## 18001 - 18206

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="18001">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />18001 FFRC - Low hourly total meter volume</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="18001">

This exception is generated when the Adjusted Total Volume in the measured unit on an hourly meter Final Form record falls below the Min limit set in the Final Form Min/Max validation in the Meter Editor. For example, on the Final Form Min/Max sub-tab, the Min/Max validation is enabled; the Condition is set to Measured; and the Min value for Volume is set to 50.0000 in the Hourly group box. When the Meter Rollup service rolls up the meter data, if an hourly final form record rolled up by the service for the meter has a measured volume less than 50, this exception is generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="18002">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />18002 FFRC - High hourly total meter volume</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="18002">

This exception is generated when the Adjusted Total Volume in the measured unit on an hourly meter Final Form record is greater than the Max limit set in the Final Form Min/Max validation in the Meter Editor. For example, on the Final Form Min/Max sub-tab, the Min/Max validation is enabled; the Condition is set to Measured; and the Max value for Volume is set to 100 in the Hourly group box. When the Meter Rollup service rolls up the meter data, if an hourly final form record for the meter rolled up by the service has a measured volume greater than 100, this exception is generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="18125">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />18125 FFRC - COSTALD density variation</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="18125">

This exception is generated for a batch on a liquid meter that uses a COSTALD product. The meter needs to have the Density Variance value of analysis validation set, and the analysis validations enabled (Run on Imports and Edits: Yes).

If the batch’s average observed density calculated from the periodic data varies from the COSTALD density calculated based on the batch temperature, pressure, and analysis by more than the density variance limit, this exception is generated.

For example, the Density Variance limit is set as 1% for a meter that uses a COSTALD product. FLOWCAL has observed density of 0.600000023841858 REL for a batch that has observed temperature of 77°F, observed pressure of 500 psi, and 100% propane. The COSTALD density is calculated to be approximately 0.501218048561296 REL for the flow parameters and analysis. The difference between the observed density and the COSTALD density is:

(0.600000023841858 – 0.501218048561296) / 0.600000023841858 \* 100% = 16.4636619%

Since this is greater than the 1% limit, exception 18125 is generated for the batch.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 608;height: 212;" />

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="18126">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />18126 FFRC - Location hourly volume variance failure</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="18126">

This exception is generated by the Location Rollup service when Adjusted Total Volume in the measured unit on an hourly location Final Form record varies from the average of previous records by more than the limit set in the Final Form Expert Systems validation configuration in the Location Validations Editor.

For example, in the Location Validations Editor Expert Systems tab, Volume/Energy is set to Measured; Expert Systems validation is enabled; and the Averaging Method is set to Running. In the Hourly group box, Volume Using is set to Yes, Percent Difference, and 2; Data Window is set to 5 Hours; and Closed Data Only is unchecked. The average volume for five previous Final Form hourly records is 43.8. The volume for the current final form hourly record is 42.7. Since the current volume differs from the average by abs((42.7/43.8) – 1) \* 100 = 2.5114 %, which is greater than the 2% limit, this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="18139">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />18139 FFRC - Unable to calculate COSTALD for batch</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="18139">

This exception is generated for a batch on a liquid meter that uses a COSTALD product where FLOWCAL cannot calculate COSTALD density for the batch because the batch does not have valid observed temperature, observed pressure, or analysis (mole%) data. The meter needs to have the Density Variance value of analysis validation set, and the analysis validations enabled (Run on Imports and Edits: Yes).

For example, the Density Variance limit is set as 1% for a meter that uses a COSTALD product. A batch on the meter has observed density of 0.489894637867965 REL and 100% propane, but observed temperature or observed pressure were not provided. The COSTALD density cannot be calculated, so exception 18139 is generated for the batch.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 619;height: 215;" />

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="18140">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="18140">

This exception is generated by the Meter Rollup service when Adjusted Total Volume in the measured unit on an hourly meter Final Form record varies from the average of previous records by more than the limit set in the Final Form Expert Systems validation configuration in the Meter Editor.

For example, in the Hourly group box, Volume Using is set to Yes, Percent Difference, and 2; Data Window is set to 5 Hours; Closed Data Only is unchecked; and Average Method is set to Running. The average volume for five previous Final Form hourly records is 43.8. The volume for the current final form hourly record is 42.7. Since the current volume differs from the average by abs((42.7/43.8) – 1) \* 100 = 2.5114 %, which is greater than the 2% limit, this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="18146">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />18146 FFRC – Low monthly location volume percent difference</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="18146">

This exception is generated when the Volume Percent Difference in the measured unit on a monthly location Final Form record is less than the Min limit set in the Min/Max validation in the Location Editor. For example, the Min/Max validation is enabled; the Volume/Energy is set to Measured; and the Min value for % Volume is set to 2 in the Monthly group box. When the Location Rollup service rolls up the location data, if a monthly final form record for the location rolled up by the service has a measured volume percent difference less than 2%, this exception is generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="18200">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />18200 LQA - Sample not found</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="18200">

This exception is generated when a valid sample is not found for any point in time on the liquid source assigned.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" style="color: #525f39;" data-mc-targets="Example 18200">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

All samples on the source have a product different than what is on the meter, all samples on the source are inhibited, or there are no samples on the source.

</div>

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="18201">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />18201 LQA - Out of tolerance sample found; not used</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="18201">

This exception is generated when a valid sample is found on the liquid source, but it is not within the time frame that is able to be applied to that record.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" style="color: #525f39;" data-mc-targets="Example 18201">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

A liquid meter has a batch with a product of "propane" from 06/01/2016 07:00:00 to 06/14/2016 07:00:00, and an LQ source has a sample for 6/28/2016 07:00:00. Within the Meter Editor of the liquid meter, the tolerance is set to seven days before the start of batch and three days after the end of batch. Within the Source Assignment editor, the "Use Prior When Current is Missing or Inhibited" option is not enabled. The exception would then be generated because there is a sample on the LQ, but FLOWCAL cannot apply it because it is out of the tolerance range.

</div>

</div>

#### 18203 LQB - No batch defined (deprecated)

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="18204">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />18204 Invalid product on meter</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="18204">

This exception is generated when a product is imported into a liquid meter and the liquid meter has not been set to expect this product in the Meter Editor. In the Meter Editor, in the Liquids tab, users can set products to validate against, if this exception is generated then the “Validate Products” option is checked and the product on the import file does not match a product from that list on the Liquids tab.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="18205">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />18205 LQB - Schedule not found for batch</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="18205">

This occurs when a Batch Movement Reconciliation is set on a location, and a batch is imported on a meter that does not have a matching schedule. After the schedule is created that matches the batch, this exception will NOT auto-resolve.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="18206">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />18206 LQA - Prior sample applied</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="18206">

This exception is for when a prior analysis is being applied to a batch or periodic record. This exception (18206) will be generated when a prior sample is applied to meter data while using the Source Assignment option 'Use Prior When Current is Missing or Inhibited'.

</div>

</div>
